# CI/CD Workflows

## Linting

Follow the root guidance: run `make lint-fix` after workflow changes.

## File Index

Autogenerated from first-line comments. Run scripts/update_agents_file_index.py to refresh.

- `workflows/android.yml`: CI workflow for Android build, lint, unit tests, and E2E tests.
- `workflows/ci.yml`: CI workflow for pushes to main.
- `workflows/pr.yml`: CI workflow for pull requests on all branches except gh-pages.
- `workflows/release.yml`: Release workflow triggered manually to build and publish versioned binaries.
